verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own quickstart docs state that SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and other frameworks are managed in one place, which covers every framework named in the story within a single platform. The support is a headline-level claim rather than in-depth per-framework documentation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on HIPAA and PCI DSS control mappings, evidence of cross-framework control reuse, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-framework use.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
help cloud-hosted companies meet and maintain compliance across standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and more
